data.title: Knightsbridge
data.about:
Knightsbridge Phase 2 has officially launched, bringing a new standard of luxury living to District 11 of Meydan. A project by Leos Developments, this exclusive collection of 5 and 6-bedroom homes offers modern architecture and unmatched comfort. The fully furnished smart homes provide residents with advanced technology, elegant interiors, and thoughtfully curated spaces.

Knightsbridge 2 at Meydan District 11 combines sophistication with convenience, offering direct access to key city routes. With Knightsbridge Phase 2 amenities including a swimmable lagoon, outdoor cinema, and running track, residents can enjoy a lifestyle of leisure and wellness. With only a 10% down payment and strong high ROI potential, this community is an excellent opportunity for investors and end-users alike.

characteristics_module.title: Knightsbridge Phase 2 by Leos – A Lifestyle Beyond Expectations
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Location Advantage – Positioned in Meydan District 11 with seamless connectivity to Downtown Dubai and major highways.
  • Smart Home Living – Fully furnished residences integrated with advanced smart technology for modern-day convenience.
  • Exclusive Amenities – Swimmable lagoon, outdoor cinema, and fitness facilities enhance leisure and wellness experiences.
  • Flexible Investment – Attractive 10% down payment and extended post-handover plan maximize affordability and security.
  • Developer Trust – Leos Developments brings proven expertise and a reputation for delivering high-quality projects in Dubai.
  • Fully Furnished Residences – Elegantly designed and ready-to-move homes offer residents ultimate comfort and convenience.
  • High ROI Potential – Strong demand for prime Meydan properties ensures lasting value for investors.

location_tile.title: Prime Address in the Heart of Meydan
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Knightsbridge 2 enjoys a sought-after setting within Meydan District 11, offering both tranquility and city convenience. The Knightsbridge Phase 2 location ensures excellent connectivity, with quick access to Dubai – Al Ain Road (E66) and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311). Residents benefit from being minutes away from schools, malls, and entertainment hubs, making it ideal for both families and investors.

  • 3 Minutes – Kent College Dubai
  • 10 Minutes – Silicon Central Mall
  • 10 Minutes – IMG Worlds of Adventure
  • 16 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
  • 17 Minutes – Downtown Dubai
  • 17 Minutes – Business Bay
